messages.subject: [IT] Document management system maintenance — Saturday 22 Feb
messages.plaintextBody:
Colleagues,

The DMS will be unavailable this Saturday 22 February from 07:00 to 13:00 for a scheduled upgrade. Please check in any documents before Friday close of business. Email and calendar are unaffected.

IT Helpdesk
